描述_EN: the first band, bordered at the top and bottom by post friezes, is decorated with a diamond pattern of small red squares adorned with an ecru spur. the three complete circles are decorated with two birds and a rosette. the second band in the dark blue field is bordered by a scalloped line, three circles and the beginning of a fourth in the upper register. within the four lozenges are two birds, a rosette and a plant element. weaving exercise with two tapestry strips. to the right of the blue field, the outline of a yellow circle on a red and green background. to the right of this blue field, woven with red, green and yellow wool, a basket of flowers and two leaning flower buds.
描述_ZN: 第一条带子，在顶部和底部以柱子的门楣为界，装饰着由红色小方块组成的钻石图案，并有一个赤褐色的凸起边缘。 三个完整的圆圈上有两只鸟和一个花环的装饰。 深蓝色领域的第二条带子的边上有一排花束，三个圆圈，上面还有第四个圆圈的开始。 四个菱形内刻有两只鸟，一个花环和一个植物元素。 用两根挂毯条进行编织练习。 在蓝田的右边，是红绿背景的黄色圆圈的开始。 在这块蓝地的右边，用红、绿、黄三色的羊毛编织了一个花篮和两个倾斜的花蕾。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
